description: Show the current org, the API key name and scopes, and the user the key acts as. `user.kind` is AGENT when the key belongs to an agent. Also reports the workspace the credentials came from (null when SPLITS_API_KEY is set), whether they came from the environment or the local keystore, and the local EOA signing keys saved by browser login, `splits auth create-key`, or `import-key`. For each local key registered with the backend, `localKeys[].signerId` is the id needed by `accounts update-signers --add-eoa-signer-ids`. This registration id differs from the account-specific id in `accounts signers`, which is used for removals. A null id means the key is unregistered or the signer lookup failed; check `auth signers` before registering it again. Also updates the org id and name saved for the workspace, which `auth workspaces` shows.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: auth_whoami
